referenceCards.profileDescription: Describe how this character speaks and should be portrayed. Current state and established facts still take priority.
referenceCards.profilePromptHint: Used as a prose portrayal constraint. Editing it invalidates unaccepted generation results.
referenceCards.profileContextHint: A truncatable reference used only when the character appears; it is not an event that already happened.
referenceCards.dialogueExamplesHint: Up to 12. Prose uses at most the first 4 and drops them first when the context budget is tight.
referenceCards.sceneOpeningHint: Up to 8. These are exchangeable inspiration only and are not added to prose prompts by default.

import.title: Import Tavern character and world cards
import.description: Upload JSON, PNG, or a standalone world book, review its safe mapping and conflicts, then decide how every item enters this novel.

upload.label: Choose character-card or world-book files
upload.hint: Select one or more Character Card V1/V2/V3 JSON files, PNG cards with chara/ccv3 metadata, or standalone SillyTavern World Info JSON files.
upload.formatsDetail: Every file uses the existing-novel Card Import Proposal preview API. Preview only stages a review proposal; it does not change formal reference cards.
upload.safetyDetail: system_prompt, post_history_instructions, depth_prompt, regex_scripts, decorators, regex behavior, and unknown extensions remain isolated. Remote assets are not downloaded.

review.title: Mapping preview and item-by-item decisions
review.description: {files} proposals contain {candidates} reference-card candidates. On merge, existing non-empty fields stay unchanged unless you explicitly select an imported value.

source.imageDiscarded: PNG image data was discarded and never stored. This version reads card metadata only.

pngClassification.pseudoV3: Pseudo V3: ccv3 only rewrites the spec and is parsed as V2

source.riskDetail: These values are retained for inspection or round trips, but remain isolated: they do not execute, download, or enter model context.
source.duplicate: The same source file was previously previewed or formally imported. The default may be skip; confirm whether you intend to import it again.

participation.notParticipating: Imported but not participating in writing
participation.notParticipatingHint: This candidate currently has no field that can be safely projected into prose context. Isolated external instructions will not be enabled as a substitute.

candidate.regexTitle: This world-book entry contains regex behavior
candidate.regexDetail: The original regex is retained, but the safe projection forces use_regex=false. It is not compiled, scanned, or allowed to trigger context injection.

notice.decorator: V3 decorator detected and kept disabled

merge.keepExistingHint: Not selected: the existing non-empty value will be kept.

complete.title: Tavern cards were written according to your decisions
complete.refreshHint: The current card list has refreshed. Candidates of other types are available in their corresponding reference-card workspaces.

errors.previewFailed: The file could not be parsed or mapped for preview.
errors.applyFailed: The proposal could not be applied. Check whether it expired or its target card changed.
errors.tooManyFiles: Select no more than {max} files at once.
errors.valueUnavailable: The API did not return the current value

curation.title: AI reference-card curation
curation.description: The model only creates candidates and never edits formal cards directly. Review each item and choose create, merge, restore and merge, or skip.
curation.loadingDetail: If you closed this window earlier, the same proposal is restored without another model call.
curation.generatingDetail: This can take tens of seconds. Formal cards stay unchanged until you apply the review.
curation.emptyTitle: Extract cards from the novel settings
curation.emptyDetail: One model request generates character, location, item, rule, and neutral lore candidates without increasing the total candidate budget. Existing same-name cards are proposed as merges.
curation.regenerateConfirm: Regenerating makes another model call and replaces the unapplied candidates. Continue?
curation.fillEmptyOnly: No non-empty field conflicts. The system only fills blanks and unions tags.
curation.summary: Create {create}, merge {merge}, restore and merge {restore}, skip {skip}
curation.appliedDetail: Created {created}, merged {merged}, restored and merged {restored}, skipped {skipped}.

factions.reservedCategory: This faction category is reserved for future volume-level and temporary local faction generation.
factions.deleteConfirmMessage: Move "{name}" to trash? Related faction relations will be hidden and can be restored later.
factions.hardDeleteConfirmMessage: Permanently delete "{name}"? This also removes invalid faction relations and cannot be undone.

writing.dangerEditMessage: This novel already has volumes/chapters. Editing these fields may cause irreversible impact on subsequent generation. Continue?

storyHealth.title: Story Health
storyHealth.description: Reads plot threads, chapter outlines, and word counts directly to surface structural signals worth an author review. It never edits prose, threads, or character data.
storyHealth.loadError: Failed to load story health data
storyHealth.needNovel: Save the novel before viewing story health signals.
storyHealth.errorWithRecovery: {error}. Recalculate to try again; this failure did not modify any data.
storyHealth.readOnlyNote: This panel only runs deterministic queries and surfaces reminders. It makes no LLM calls and never writes or repairs data automatically.

summary.noProgress: No outline or prose progress to measure yet

stateBackfill.title: AI State Backfill
stateBackfill.needContent: This chapter has no saved prose yet. Write and save the prose first.
stateBackfill.needTitleToSave: Prose cannot be saved while the chapter title is empty. Add a title first.
stateBackfill.stalePreview: The state preview is missing valid confirmation data. Regenerate it before accepting.
stateBackfill.running: Reading the prose and extracting state…
stateBackfill.factsLabel: New permanent facts (written when checked; cannot be deleted afterwards)
stateBackfill.issuesLabel: Consistency conflicts (advisory only; does not block accepting)
stateBackfill.issuesEmpty: No conflicts with existing permanent facts were found.
stateBackfill.acceptSuccess: Wrote {states} character states, {facts} permanent facts, {threads} thread changes.
stateBackfill.skippedDuplicates: {count} permanent facts duplicated existing facts for this chapter and were skipped: {facts}
stateBackfill.emptyResult: The AI proposed no state changes.
stateBackfill.droppedIdsWarning: The AI referenced {count} item(s) not in the roster; they were dropped: {detail}
stateBackfill.remappedIdsNotice: {count} unique name(s) or alias(es) were mapped to formal character IDs: {detail}

stateAudit.title: State completeness audit
stateAudit.description: Read-only check of whether each chapter's prose still matches its accepted state backfill. It never calls a model or rewrites history.
stateAudit.readOnlyNotice: This is a read-only list. “Rerun backfill” only locates the chapter and opens the existing state workflow; prose and summaries are not rewritten.
stateAudit.legacyNotice: {count} chapter(s) contain legacy data without enough evidence and are shown for manual review only.
stateAudit.emptyTitle: No attention items in this scope
stateAudit.emptyDescription: Turn off the attention-only filter to see legal empty and current chapters.
stateAudit.repairLocated: The affected chapter is selected; the state panel will regenerate from the existing prose.
